carefirst.authModel: Read-only database replica with a nightly extract; no write-back because the system is no longer developed.
carefirst.notes: Used for history during the migration period. Retire once ECLIPSE holds the full history.

eclipse.authModel: Council single sign-on (Entra ID) with ECLIPSE API keys held by the council; the platform reads via the ECLIPSE integration layer.
eclipse.cadence: Near real time for referrals and allocations; outcomes (registration, case conference decisions) pushed back on approval of the minute.
eclipse.notes: ECLIPSE remains the council case record. The platform holds the multi-agency picture and writes back decisions, not case notes.

emisWeb.authModel: NHS Scotland national identity with a practice-level data sharing agreement; the platform holds a service account per health board.
emisWeb.cadence: Nightly pull for people with an open process; on-demand pull for an s10 records request; flags pushed on the day they are placed.
emisWeb.notes: Health records are only inspected by a health professional. The adapter returns coded events, never free-text consultation notes.

ivpd.authModel: Police Scotland secure gateway with a signed data sharing agreement per Chief Officers Group; the platform is a receiving system only.
ivpd.cadence: Concern reports arrive within an hour of submission and land in the concern hub inbox.
ivpd.notes: The platform never writes to police systems. Charges and bail conditions are offence data and are shared onward only under a recorded lawful basis.

morse.authModel: As TrakCare, via the health board integration engine.
morse.notes: Community contacts for children under five are the richest early-years signal in the chronology.

opg.authModel: OPG public register search plus an authorised enquirer account for councils and health boards.
opg.cadence: On demand when an AWI or ASP financial harm process opens.
opg.displayName: OPG register (powers of attorney and guardianship)
opg.notes: The result is a register extract: whether a power exists, its type, the attorney or guardian, and dates.
opg.systemName: Office of the Public Guardian register

scra.authModel: SCRA secure referral gateway; the platform sends the referral decision and the Reporter returns the outcome.
scra.notes: Every IRD and CPPM records whether a referral was made; the adapter sends the decision and reason.

seemis.authModel: Council education directorate account with SEEMIS Group API access; the named person authorises pulls for their pupils.
seemis.cadence: Attendance monthly; pastoral categories and exclusions same day; child protection register status pushed as a pupil flag.
seemis.notes: Free-text pastoral notes never leave SEEMIS. The head teacher promotes what is relevant.

trakcare.authModel: Health board integration engine with a patient-level consent and safeguarding override model; Caldicott guardian sign-off on the sharing agreement.
trakcare.cadence: Encounters within four hours of discharge.
trakcare.notes: Diagnoses are not pulled; encounter type, date and screening outcome only.

visor.authModel: No data connection. ViSOR access stays inside the police and RA secure estate; the platform stores the nominal reference typed in by the MAPPA Coordinator.
visor.notes: When MAPPS replaces ViSOR the same reference field applies.

questions.q14: Has the person ever threatened to kill you or someone else and you believed them?
questions.q15: Has the person ever attempted to strangle, choke, suffocate or drown you?
questions.q16: Does the person do or say things of a sexual nature that make you feel bad or physically hurt you?
questions.q17: Is there any other person who has threatened you or who you are afraid of?
questions.q18: Do you know if the person has hurt anyone else?
questions.q19: Has the person ever mistreated an animal or the family pet?
questions.q20: Are there any financial issues, for example are you dependent on the person for money?
questions.q21: Has the person had problems in the past year with drugs, alcohol or mental health?
questions.q22: Has the person ever threatened or attempted suicide?
questions.q23: Has the person ever breached bail or an injunction, or formal agreements about contact?
questions.q24: Do you know if the person has ever been in trouble with the police or has a criminal history?
questions.q25: Were any children present during, or exposed to, the incident?
questions.q26: Has the person ever threatened to hurt the children or to take them away?
questions.q27: Are there concerns about the children's safety or wellbeing arising from the abuse?
questions.q3: What are you afraid of? Is it further injury or violence?
questions.q4: Do you feel isolated from family or friends?
questions.q5: Are you feeling depressed or having suicidal thoughts?
questions.q6: Have you separated or tried to separate in the past year?
questions.q7: Is there conflict over child contact?

questions.q9: Are you pregnant or have you recently had a baby?
